title: 黑石与阿波罗洽谈获准收购NFL球队少数股权
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Out of some breaking news, Scarlett, what's the latest? Yeah, we were just talking about the NFL in general Atlantic.
segments.zh: 插播最新消息，斯嘉丽，最新情况如何？我们刚才在聊NFL和大西洋队。

segments.en: Well, Bloomberg is now reporting that Apollo and Blackstone are in talks for NFL approval to buy team stakes.
segments.zh: 彭博社报道，阿波罗和黑石正与NFL洽谈，寻求批准购买球队股份。

segments.en: This is according to people familiar with the matter. Discussions are still preliminary, but if it happens, they would join the league's list of approved PE buyers
segments.zh: 据知情人士透露，谈判尚处初步阶段，若成功，它们将加入联盟批准的私募股权买家名单。

segments.en: when the NFL began solely opening itself up to institutional investment, beginning its PE policy two years ago.
segments.zh: 两年前NFL开始向机构资本开放，推出私募股权**政策。

segments.en: We should know all three parties have declined to comment on this report.
segments.zh: 据悉，三方均对该报道拒绝置评。
